evals.name: books-by-genre
evals.prompt: Group book cards by genre with a dimension named byGenre, even though books have no byGenre property.
evals.expected_output: The dimension identifies a grouping and its getter reads genre.
assertions: Supplies a unique dimension key byGenre and a Genre label.
Returns book.genre from getValue without requiring a matching key property.
Uses book.id for identity and book.title for the card.

evals.name: monthly-groups
evals.prompt: Group dated books by calendar month rather than individual instants.
evals.expected_output: The dimension getter returns the intended year-month label.
assertions: Derives a year-month string from each record in getValue.
Does not require adding the dimension key as a stored field.
Preserves independent book IDs for cards sharing the month.

evals.name: book-history
evals.prompt: Show versions of a book and open its most recent snapshot first.
evals.expected_output: TimeMachine receives versions and an initial index.
assertions: Orders versions oldest first with id, Date timestamp, label and rendered content.
Handles no versions before seeding the newest index.
Uses onVersionChange rather than treating currentVersionIndex as controlled after mount.
